# This is an example mods.toml file.
modLoader="javafml" #mandatory
# A version range to match for said mod loader - for regular FML @Mod it will be the forge version
loaderVersion="[47,)" #mandatory This is typically bumped every Minecraft version by Forge. See our download page for lists of versions.
# The license for you mod.
license="ARR"
[[mods]] #mandatory
# The modid of the mod
modId="bookofdragons" #mandatory
# The version number of the mod
version="1.4-1.20.1" #mandatory
# A display name for the mod
displayName="Book of Dragons" #mandatory
# A URL to query for updates for this mod.
logoFile="bookofdragons.png" #optional
authors="MrMagister, AuroranKingslayer" #optional
credits="Serpyderpy, DocMchief, AsteriTheVeloci, IMRSD, Ness, XStatic, Anisa, TemplarPhoenix, Will, TristanTheSaurianKing, Seahorse, Chrys" #optional

# The description text for the mod (multi line!) (#mandatory)
description='''A Dreamworks Dragons/ How to Train Your Dragon themed mod that introduces dragons from the movies and shows that you can tame and interact with.'''
# A dependency - use the . to indicate dependency for a specific modid. Dependencies are optional.
[[dependencies.bookofdragons]] #optional
    # the modid of the dependency
    modId="forge" #mandatory
    # Does this dependency have to exist - if not, ordering below must be specified
    mandatory=true #mandatory
    # The version range of the dependency
    versionRange="[47.4.0,)" #mandatory
    # An ordering relationship for the dependency.
    ordering="NONE"
    # Side this dependency is applied on - both, client, or server
    side="BOTH"
# Here's another dependency
[[dependencies.bookofdragons]]
    modId="minecraft"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="[1.20.1,1.21)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

# AzureLib: only the versions this mod is built and tested against.
[[dependencies.bookofdragons]]
    modId="azurelib"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="[3.2.0]"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

# Features are specific properties of the game environment, that you may want to declare you require.

# FAUNA Engine (liberanimalium) - the creature library this mod is built on, its own mod in its own jar.
[[dependencies.bookofdragons]]
    modId="liberanimalium"
    mandatory=true
    versionRange="[1.0,)"
    ordering="AFTER"
    side="BOTH"
